page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration featuring a memory-rich ratio of 7.5 GB per vCPU. The instance allocates 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core and 2 hardware threads on an Intel Xeon 8581C processor running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. Memory capacity totals 15.0 GB, accompanied by 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 260 MB of shared L3 cache. The x86_64 architecture incorporates advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, AMX (Tile and INT8), and hardware cryptography accelerators. This instance profile includes no attached local storage and no dedicated GPUs, requiring network-attached persistent storage for filesystem operations.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-threaded compute capability contrasted with aggregate throughput limits inherent to its dual-vCPU footprint. The instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 2229.0, placing it within the top 10 percent of tested systems, corroborated by strong single-threaded compression speeds of 34.51 GB/sec in gzip and 14.46 GB/sec in bzip3 decompression. In contrast, multi-core benchmarks show modest scaling due to the single-core physical boundary, registering 2739.0 in Geekbench multi-core and 1960.58 in stress-ng multi-core tests. Potentially uncached large-block memory bandwidth measures 18.79 GB/sec read and 12.28 GB/sec write, reflecting entry-tier memory bus saturation under heavy sequential memory access.

Given its provision of 15.0 GB RAM against a single physical execution core, the c4-highmem-2 offers cost-efficient headroom for memory-bound tasks that do not justify high core-count licensing or compute expenditure. It supports operational throughput of 3.02 million Redis SET operations per second and 4.84 GB/sec in static web serving. The configuration is well suited for caching tiers, low-traffic relational databases, background batch workers, and small-model inference tasks where per-thread responsiveness and memory headroom take precedence over parallel compute density.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-2 is a dual-vCPU instance delivering a high memory-to-compute ratio with 15.0 GB of RAM backed by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8581C processor running at 2.3 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture with 1 physical core and 2 threads, it features hardware support for AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets, with zero local disk storage and no GPU hardware. Performance profiles show top-tier single-core Geekbench metrics (2229.0) and high single-threaded compression throughput, while overall multi-threaded throughput remains bounded by the 2-vCPU allocation. Memory throughput reaches 18.79 GB/sec read and 12.28 GB/sec write on uncached blocks. The machine configuration provides a cost-efficient profile for memory-demanding services requiring modest parallel compute capacity, making it a reliable fit for memory caching, lightweight database instances, microservices, and small-model text processing workloads.
